scripts.bootstrap: npm --prefix frontend install && python -m pip install -r backend/requirements.txt
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.validate: npm run validate:frontend && npm run validate:backend
scripts.validate:frontend: npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix frontend run test -- --watch=false
scripts.validate:backend: python -m compileall backend && python -m unittest discover -s backend/tests
